title: Extreme weather mars 4th of July weekend; seaplane makes hard landing in NYC river
summary: A number of cities broke temperature records over the Fourth of July weekend. In storm-ravaged New Jersey, authorities say at least 19 deaths are blamed on the heat. Meanwhile, a seaplane was forced to make a hard landing in New York City's East River on Sunday. Shanelle Kaul reports on it all and meteorologist Andrew Kozak has a look at the forecast.
